message: Live Windows 2.2.12 evidence: the saved control conversation now renders ChatGPT UI error 'Не удалось загрузить этот разговор ChatGPT' and turn 41 remains stuck target=GPT. This is a hard inaccessible-control-chat case, not transient zero_messages. Fix as Dispatcher 2.2.13 in agent-handoff only. Requirements: (1) Detect a hard unavailable control conversation from the rendered ChatGPT error state (Russian/English equivalents or existing control error markers) without logging message text. Distinguish this from transient zero_messages/composer-not-ready. (2) On confirmed hard-unavailable saved control URL, permit exactly one bounded control rebind/reprovision for that saved URL even if recovery_used=true. This must use a separate persistent latch, e.g. rebind_for_url/rebind_attempted_at/rebind_count, and MUST NOT reset recovery_used, recovery_reason, recovered_from, bootstrap history, or GitHub state. (3) Rebind must create at most one fresh service ChatGPT page/chat, navigate to ChatGPT home/new-chat, verify composer availability, send CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP exactly once, wait for a usable newly-created conversation URL, then atomically replace chatgpt_control_url with that observed URL. Preserve the previous URL as replaced_from or equivalent audit metadata. (4) If ChatGPT is signed out, composer unavailable, or new chat creation fails, fail closed with cooldown; do not create another page/chat on every poll. Never navigate or modify unrelated existing ChatGPT conversations. (5) After new control chat is created, normal CONTROL READY / idle-grace readiness applies; once ready, pending wake turn_id=41 must be sent exactly once under existing de-duplication. (6) Do not resend bootstrap to the inaccessible old chat. Do not clear restore/recovery safeguards except the specific restore latch necessary after successful rebind. (7) Add pure/integration tests for: hard-unavailable detection RU+EN; zero_messages alone does not trigger rebind; one rebind only per old saved URL; failed rebind cooldown/no tab growth; successful new chat URL persistence; metadata preservation; pending wake de-dup after rebind. Preserve 2.2.10 raw-to-api failover, CHECK_INTERVAL, and text-free logs. Do not modify main or arena/local-agent-v0. Do not enable Phase 2/live mailbox. After commit write turn_id=43 target=GPT with SHA, changed files, exact tests, and rebind semantics.
